name: Arcane Sphere Of Faces
description: Masses of graven glintstone faces bound into a grotesque sphere, safeguarding the basement cellar of Witchbane Ruins. Born from primeval sorcery experiments.
location: Witchbane Ruins, Liurnia & Caelid

name: Giant Bat
description: Nocturnal winged predators nesting near dark cliffs, cave ceilings, and ruins throughout the Lands Between. Often rest during daylight unless disturbed.
location: Limgrave, Weeping Peninsula, Liurnia

name: Lesser Runebear
description: Massive, ferociously aggressive bears bearing intricate runic patterns across their chest fur. Scavenge forests and hillsides with tremendous physical power.
location: Mistwood, Eastern Limgrave & Weeping Peninsula

name: Abnormal Stone Cluster
description: Bizarre caterpillar-shaped beings formed of spherical moss-covered stones centered around an eerie human-like eye. Found guarding ancient Evergaols.
location: Evergaols across Limgrave, Liurnia and Altus Plateau

name: Basilisk
description: Repulsive reptiles dwelling in dark caverns and deep subterranean waterways, swollen with large bulbous false eyes. They expel clouds of deadly Death Blight fog.
location: Ainsel River, Deeproot Depths, Lake of Rot, Subterranean Shunning-Grounds

name: Bladed Talon Eagle
description: Servants of Stormveil Castle fitted with vicious steel talons and explosive barrels, driven by cruel training to divebomb intruders.
location: Stormveil Castle

name: Boar
description: Sturdy wild swine roaming the woodlands and plains of Limgrave and Stormhill. Generally non-hostile unless cornered or attacked.
location: Forests of Limgrave and Stormhill

name: Burning Slug
description: Sluggish gastropods radiating intense heat and molten slime, roaming thermal springs and magma-soaked terrain.
location: Liurnia of the Lakes, Mt. Gelmir

name: Crab
description: Common crustaceans scuttling along the beaches, rivers, and shallow marshes of Limgrave and the Weeping Peninsula.
location: Beaches and shallow waters of Limgrave

name: Construct
description: Enchanted stone constructs animated by primeval magic to excavate tunnels and defend ancient underground chambers.
location: Sealed Tunnel, Altus Plateau

name: Deer
description: Graceful herbivores roaming undisturbed across the open plains and valleys of the Lands Between.
location: Plains and forests across Limgrave and Liurnia

name: Dog
description: Feral canines hunting in packs across ruins and highways, quick to snap and bite with vicious agility.
location: Dragon-Burnt Ruins, Limgrave

name: Giant Dragonfly
description: Enormous insects flitting erratically above marshes and lakes, harassing travelers with sharp aerial maneuvers.
location: Agheel Lake, Limgrave, Liurnia shallows

name: Direwolf
description: Large predatory wolves prowling the cold courtyards of Caria Manor and wooded ridges of Liurnia.
location: Caria Manor, Liurnia of the Lakes

name: Eagle
description: Majestic birds of prey roosting high on sea-facing cliffs and rocky outcroppings throughout Limgrave and Stormhill.
location: Cliffs of Limgrave and Stormhill

name: Giant Crab
description: Massive armoured crustaceans inhabiting wetlands and shorelines, swinging heavy pincers and spitting high-pressure torrents of water.
location: Agheel Lake, Liurnia of the Lakes, Leyndell Moat

name: Giant Land Octopus
description: Grotesque terrestrial cephalopods armed with multiple flailing tentacles and a hardened beak, feeding on blood along marshy shores.
location: Shores and shallow waters of Limgrave and Liurnia

name: Giant Lobster
description: Enormous freshwater crustaceans that skitter through murky lakebeds, capable of sniping prey from great distances with razor-sharp water jets.
location: Liurnia of the Lakes, Subterranean Shunning-Grounds

name: Giant Poison Flower
description: Colossal sentient blossom rooted in ruins and damp groves, capable of releasing clouds of lethal poison and calling down beams of divine light.
location: Post Town Remains, Limgrave, Weeping Peninsula

name: Giant Rat
description: Vile, disease-carrying rodents nesting in dark tunnels, cellars, and catacombs, attacking in aggressive swarms.
location: Cellars and caves across Limgrave, Weeping Peninsula, and Altus Plateau

name: Guillemot
description: Docile seabirds nesting on ocean bluffs and rocky beaches, easily frightened away by passing travelers.
location: Beaches and bluffs of Western Limgrave

name: Lesser Runebear
description: Feral giant bears bearing ancient runic chest markings, roaming forests with immense vitality and vicious charging strikes.
location: Forests of Limgrave and Weeping Peninsula

name: Lesser Red Wolf Of Radagon
description: Acrobatic scarlet-furred wolves possessing sorcerous glintblade enchantments, prowling wild grounds and sacred chambers.
location: Liurnia of the Lakes, Moonlight Altar, Nokron

name: Lesser Spider Hand
description: Small, severed multi-fingered hands that skitter across the floors and walls of Carian grounds, ambushing unwary travelers.
location: Caria Manor, Liurnia of the Lakes

name: Land Octopus
description: Smaller juvenile land octopuses that cluster in coastal tide pools and lake margins, feeding on detritus.
location: Agheel Lake and coastal shallows of Limgrave

name: Owl
description: Solitary nocturnal birds perched quietly on rocky bluffs and gravestones, observant of wandering travelers.
location: Cliffs and ruins of Stormhill and Limgrave

name: Poison Flower
description: Carnivorous blooming plant that spews venomous spores upon any who approach its leafy domain.
location: Waypoint Ruins, Limgrave

name: Land Squirt
description: Bulbous, tubular organisms growing in clusters in wetlands, releasing poison gas clouds to sicken and dissolve prey.
location: Dragon-Burnt Ruins, shores of Limgrave and Liurnia

name: Rat
description: Small scurrying rodents infesting abandoned cellars, dungeons, and sewers throughout the Lands Between.
location: Limgrave Tunnels, Ailing Village, Tombsward Cave

name: Rabbitgaroo
description: Gentle, skittish creatures unique to the Lands Between, hopping across grassy hillsides with long hind legs.
location: Plains and hillocks of Limgrave and Liurnia

name: Rotten Stray
description: Diseased hounds festering with Scarlet Rot, lunging with feral desperation to spread infection through bite wounds.
location: Limgrave Tunnels, Caelid highways

name: Sheep
description: Feral horned sheep grazing peacefully across the hills and pastures of Limgrave, rolling away when threatened.
location: Pastures of Limgrave and Stormhill

name: Skeletal Slime
description: Amorphous gelatinous blobs infused with bones and necromantic residue, creeping along damp shallows and catacombs.
location: Agheel Lake, coastal shallows of Limgrave

name: Spirit Jellyfish
description: Floating spectral cnidarians illuminating the night air, gently drifting near graves unless provoked.
location: Cemeteries and hillsides of Stormhill and Liurnia

name: Teardrop Scarab
description: Mythical scarabs rolling spheres of sacred dew. Striking them replenishes flasks or yields valuable sorceries, incantations, and smithing stones.
location: Scattered throughout all regions of the Lands Between

name: Spider Hand
description: Monstrous multi-jointed hands formed from spliced corpses, skittering across walls and burying into ground to crush trespassers.
location: Caria Manor, Mountaintops of the Giants

name: Wild Mouflon
description: Stout, curved-horned wild rams inhabiting rugged highlands, defending their herd by charging forward with blunt force.
location: Stormhill and Altus Plateau highlands

name: Turtle
description: Docile shelled reptiles resting near ponds and rivers, revered for meat renowned for boosting stamina recovery.
location: Lakes and grassy plains of West Limgrave

name: Wolf
description: Pack hunters stalking the forests and foothills of Limgrave, howling to coordinate vicious flanking maneuvers.
location: Groveside Cave, Mistwood, Stormhill

name: Prawn Miner
description: Insectoid worshippers of the Scarlet Rot wielding barbed pest glaives and firing homing pest thread spikes from afar.
location: Sellia Crystal Tunnel, Caelid

name: Farum Azula Dragon
description: Lesser ancient dragons roosting amid the ruins of Crumbling Farum Azula, wielding red lightning and breath of searing flame.
location: Crumbling Farum Azula

name: Bloody Finger Nerijus
description: A savage invader who hunts fellow Tarnished along the murky ravines of Limgrave, wielding the dual-bleed dagger Reduvia.
location: Murkwater Ravine, Limgrave

name: Anastasia, Tarnished-eater
description: A cannibalistic maiden masquerading as a Finger Maiden who ambushes Tarnished travelers with a heavy Butchering Knife.
location: Smoldering Church, Mt. Gelmir, Consecrated Snowfield

name: Bloody Finger Okina
description: A master swordsman hailing from the Land of Reeds who succumbed to the allure of blood, wielding the devastating katana Rivers of Blood.
location: Church of Repose, Mountaintops of the Giants

name: Edgar The Revenger
description: Driven mad with grief after the slaughter of his daughter Irina, Castellan Edgar hunts trespassers as an invader at the Revenger's Shack.
location: Revenger's Shack, Liurnia of the Lakes

name: Inquisitor Ghiza
description: A sadistic torturer of Volcano Manor who challenges Tarnished in the manor's upper dining hall with a whirling spiked iron wheel.
location: Volcano Manor (Upper Floor)

name: Mad Tongue Alberich
description: An outcast sorcerer whose phantom lingers in the lower sanctum of Roundtable Hold, casting chilling frostbite and thorn spells.
location: Roundtable Hold (Lower Hall)

name: Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan
description: The cloaked castellan of the Shaded Castle, devoted to the worship of Malenia, fighting with the scarlet-rot infused Antspur Rapier.
location: Fields west of The Shaded Castle, Altus Plateau

name: Moongrum Carian Knight
description: The stalwart Carian Knight standing sentinel before the Grand Library of Raya Lucaria, parrying strikes with effortless grace.
location: Raya Lucaria Academy (Grand Library Courtyard)

name: Preceptor Miriam
description: An elusive sorcerous apparition guarding the balconies of Carian Study Hall, firing magical greatbow arrows and downpours of glintstones.
location: Carian Study Hall, Liurnia

name: Recusant Henricus
description: An early Volcano Manor recusant who invades wanderers venturing near the Stormhill colosseum road.
location: East of Stormhill Shack, Limgrave

name: Albinauric
description: Second-generation artificial humanoids with round, frog-like heads. Despite clumsy waddling, they cartwheel nimbly and strike in frenzied bands.
location: Liurnia of the Lakes, Palace Approach Ledge-Road

name: Albinauric Wolfback Archer
description: First-generation female Albinaurics riding silver direwolves, sniping trespassers with deadly pinpoint accuracy from great distances.
location: Consecrated Snowfield, Ordina Liturgical Town

name: Banished Knight
description: Disgraced heavy knights exiled from their homelands, bound to defend fortifications with whirlwind swordplay and halberd sweeps.
location: Stormveil Castle, Cathedral of Dragon Communion, Castle Sol

name: Azula Beastman
description: Ferocious feral beastmen of Farum Azula, wielding primitive stone cleavers and displaying savage acrobatic agility.
location: Crumbling Farum Azula, Dragonbarrow Cave

name: Baleful Shadow
description: A lethal shadow-assassin taking the form of a crimson-eyed wolf warrior, sent by the Two Fingers to thwart Ranni's rebellion.
location: Nokstella, Ainsel River Main

name: Blackflame Monk
description: Apostles of the Godskin who turned from holy flames to wield god-slaying black flames, guarding subterranean vaults.
location: Divine Tower of Caelid, Temple of Eiglay

name: Perfumer
description: Apothecaries of Leyndell who transmuted herbal medicine into devastating weapons of fire and toxic smog during the Shattering.
location: Leyndell Royal Capital, Perfumer's Ruins

name: Black Knight
description: Harbingers of death clad in pitch-black armor, patrolling roads and bridges atop shadowy steeds under cover of darkness.
location: Bridge near Agheel Lake North, patrolling at night

name: Godrick Knight
description: Elite armored commanders in service to Godrick the Grafted, leading footmen and wielding heavy partisan spears or greatswords.
location: Gatefront Ruins, Fort Haight, Limgrave

name: Castle Guard
description: Condemned penal soldiers clad in red hoods and padded mail, garrisoned to defend Stormveil's parapets and courtyards.
location: Stormveil Castle

name: Chanting Winged Dame
description: Hideous bat-winged hags that sing mournful Latin hymns across misty ravines, suddenly swooping to poison and claw intruders.
location: Ruin-Strewn Precipice, Liurnia, Fort Faroth

name: Clayman
description: Mute, mud-sculpted priests and denizens of subterranean rivers, armed with stone harpoons and ancient bubble sorceries.
location: Siofra River, Ainsel River

name: Commoner
description: Gaunt, subservient human laborers who perform menial tasks and guard castle perimeters with knives and torches.
location: Stormveil Castle, Leyndell, Volcano Manor

name: Demi-human
description: Small, aggressive pack humanoids scavenging in coastal caves and forests, led by larger tribal chieftains.
location: Caves and forests across Limgrave and Weeping Peninsula

name: Fire Monk
description: Devout custodians of the Giants' Flame who wield fire-blessed maces and cast flame incantations across the hills of Liurnia.
location: Monk encampments in East Liurnia of the Lakes

name: Sorcerer Miner
description: Enslaved miners infused with glintstone crystallization, using magic-tipped pickaxes to extract ores and strike intruders.
location: Altus Tunnel, Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel

name: Flame Guardian
description: Mysterious bronze-masked priests stationed at mountain garrisons, channeling flame pillars from ceremonial braziers.
location: Guardians' Garrison, Mountaintops of the Giants

name: Glintstone Sorcerer
description: Scholars of Raya Lucaria wearing stone crowns, casting glintstone pebble volleys from their study halls and courtyards.
location: Raya Lucaria Academy

name: Gnoll
description: Cannibalistic beast warriors roaming the crumbling architecture of Farum Azula, swift and brutal in melee combat.
location: Crumbling Farum Azula

name: Godrick Soldier
description: Standard foot soldiers bearing Godrick's twin-headed axe crest, patrolling gatefront ruins and roads in disciplined squads.
location: Gatefront Ruins, Stormgate, Limgrave

name: Golem
description: Colossal stone sentinels constructed in ancient eras, awakening from centuries of slumber to stomp and fire heavy greatbow ballistas.
location: Stormhill, Castle Morne ramparts, Ainsel River Well

name: Highwayman
description: Former soldiers turned cutthroats who ambush travelers in caves and narrow ravines using hidden bells and swift daggers.
location: Murkwater Cave, Limgrave

name: Great Horned Tragoth
description: A famed chivalrous knight renowned for aiding countless Tarnished, targeted for assassination by Volcano Manor atop the precipice.
location: Ruin-Strewn Precipice (Volcano Manor assassination contract)

name: Gold Dragon Cult Knight
description: Elite golden knight of Leyndell wielding ancient dragon lightning incantations and high-poise sword strikes.
location: South of Artist's Shack, Liurnia of the Lakes

name: Imp
description: Nimble stone gargoyles lurking in catacombs, clinging to ceilings and ambushing travelers with bleeding hatchets and throwing pots.
location: Catacombs throughout Limgrave, Liurnia, and Altus

name: Imp Miner
description: Small stone constructs deployed in cliffside mining scaffolds, ambushing workers and intruders with flying flail strikes.
location: Ruin-Strewn Precipice

name: Invisible Warrior
description: Concealed scion of the Black Knives cloaked in invisibility veils, stalking the freezing alleys of the liturgical town to backstab unwary souls.
location: Ordina Liturgical Town (Evergaol)

name: Juno Hoslow, Knight Of Blood
description: The master of House Hoslow who swore to uphold his lineage in blood, refusing Volcano Manor's invitation and defending his snowbound estate.
location: Shack of the Lofty, Mountaintops of the Giants

name: Imp
description: Carved stone imps stationed in underground crypts, leaping from darkened perches to inflict rapid blood loss.
location: Catacombs throughout the Lands Between

name: Lesser Burial Watchdog
description: Mechanical feline statues animated to guard underground heroes' graves, wielding elemental fire and stone blades with unnatural levitation.
location: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, Mountaintops of the Giants

name: Knight Of Zamor
description: Ancient, lanky warriors from the legendary war with the Giants, drifting across battlefield snow with frost-wreathed curved blades.
location: Zamor Ruins, Mountaintops of the Giants

name: Lesser Pumpkin Head
description: Burly, feral giants wearing heavy bronze pumpkin helms to dull madness, swinging flails and headbutting ground targets.
location: Castle Morne, Raya Lucaria Academy, Limgrave

name: Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit
description: Writhing mass of corrupted roots and pustules slumbering deep in castle crypts, violently thrashing and detonating holy bursts.
location: Stormveil Castle (Crypt)

name: Living Jar
description: Sentient earthenware jars filled with flesh and bone, spinning and smashing intruders to protect the peace of jar communities.
location: Stormhill, Liurnia, Jarburg, Mt. Gelmir

name: Lesser Wormface
description: Grotesque cloaked wanderers whose visages are obscured by squirming parasitic worms, vomiting streams of death-inducing blight.
location: Minor Erdtree in Altus Plateau, Crumbling Farum Azula

name: Maneuverable Flamethrower
description: Mechanized wooden carriages propelled by fire monks, spewing continuous jets of flame from an ornamental carved visage.
location: Liurnia of the Lakes, Guardians' Garrison

name: Marionette Gargoyle
description: Winged mechanical puppets perched along church roofs, swooping down with twin scythes to protect academy secrets.
location: Raya Lucaria Academy

name: Marionette Soldier
description: Four-armed wooden clockwork automata created by Carian sorcerers, capable of firing multiple bows or flailing wild blade combos.
location: Raya Lucaria Academy, Academy Gate Town

name: Miner
description: Toughened laborers whose flesh has petrified into stone, toiling tirelessly in dark shafts and defending tunnels with heavy pickaxes.
location: Limgrave Tunnels, Sellia Crystal Tunnel

name: Mounted Northern Mercenary
description: Horseback Kaiden raiders patrolling outposts with two-handed curved greatswords, striking from saddleback with heavy slashes.
location: Highways and plains of Limgrave and Stormhill

name: Mounted Knight
description: Heavily armored knight mounted on a barded warhorse, patrolling key crossroads across Limgrave and Liurnia with lance and greatshield.
location: Roads of Northeast Limgrave & Northern Liurnia

name: Noble Sorcerer
description: Feeble aristocratic scholars in ragged finery, wandering roadways while leaning on crude glintstone staves to fire weak spells.
location: Caravans and ruins across Limgrave and Liurnia

name: Misbegotten
description: Winged, chimeric sub-humans cast down as slaves throughout the Lands Between, rebelling in bloodthirsty fury with iron cleavers.
location: Castle Morne, Weeping Peninsula, Mt. Gelmir

name: Kaiden Sellsword
description: Rugged northern mercenaries hailing from the wintry highlands of Kaiden, wielding hefty Dismounters with savage martial discipline.
location: Encampments across Limgrave and Stormhill

name: Omen
description: Hulking cursed humanoids born with tangled knot-horns across their bodies, imprisoned in dark pits and wielding massive cleavers.
location: Stormveil Castle courtyard, Subterranean Shunning-Grounds

name: Pendulum Statue
description: Ornate mechanical iron maidens rolling on wheels, extending swinging sickle pendulums and opening iron cages to swallow victims.
location: Raya Lucaria Academy, Volcano Manor

name: Old Knight Istvan
description: A veteran Tarnished warrior clad in dragon-scale armor, targeted as Volcano Manor's very first contract on the windswept hills of Limgrave.
location: Stormhill (Volcano Manor contract)

name: Perfumer
description: Court herbalists and combat chemists who disperse clouds of flaming starlight and boosting aromatics in battle.
location: Leyndell Royal Capital, Perfumer's Grotto

name: Pumpkin Head
description: Towering mad brute wearing an iron pumpkin helmet to suppress sensory overload, flailing wildly with heavy spiky flails.
location: Castle Morne, Weeping Peninsula, Waypoint Ruins

name: Raya Lucaria Sorcerer
description: Scholars of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, studying the arcane mysteries of the stars and striking intruders with Glintstone sorceries.
location: Raya Lucaria Academy

name: Rileigh The Idle
description: A lethal assassin from the Crepus confederacy who uses concealing veils and a venomous crossbow, marked for execution by Volcano Manor.
location: Altus Plateau ravine (Volcano Manor contract)

name: Revenant
description: Horrific multi-limbed amalgamations grafted together into arachnid horrors, screaming through magical portals and unleashing flurries of poisoned slaps.
location: Liurnia of the Lakes, Kingsrealm Ruins, Elphael

name: Servant Of Rot
description: Fanatical worshippers of the goddess of rot whose heads have mutated into parasitic fungal caps, spewing toxic mist and throwing fungal daggers.
location: Stillwater Cave, Caelid Waypoint Ruins

name: Raya Lucarian Warden
description: Elite armored watchmen patrolling the halls of Raya Lucaria Academy, defending scholars with crystalline shields and thrusting swords.
location: Raya Lucaria Academy

name: Soldier
description: Regular infantry garrisons guarding fortifications and roadways, equipped with shields, straight swords, and cross-guard spears.
location: Stormveil Castle, Gatefront, Weeping Peninsula

name: Skeleton Mage
description: Necromantic undead sorcerers emerging from graves to cast floating spirit skulls and summon spectral allies.
location: Graveyards and ruins across Liurnia of the Lakes

name: Skeleton
description: Restless bones of deceased warriors reanimated by Deathroot, reforming repeatedly unless struck down with holy armaments.
location: Cemeteries, ruins, and catacombs across Limgrave

name: Slender Wayfarer
description: Ancient extraterrestrial lifeforms said to have risen after a meteor strike, manipulating gravitational force to pull in and crush foes.
location: Seaside Ruins beach, Limgrave

name: Swordstress
description: Nimble priestess-warriors of the Eternal Cities, wielding liquid-metal flowing whips and swords with graceful, flowing motions.
location: Nokron, Night's Sacred Ground, Nokstella

name: Troll
description: Enslaved giant humanoids used as draft beasts or shock troops, swinging massive stone pillars and sweeping clubs with earth-shattering force.
location: Stormhill highway, Caria Manor, Altus Plateau

name: Troll Knight
description: Distinguished trolls granted chivalric rank by the Carian royal family, outfitted in ornate steel plate armor and wielding enchanted Greatswords.
location: Caria Manor staircase, Liurnia of the Lakes

name: Undead Soldier
description: Decayed foot soldiers wandering aimlessly across ruined battlefields, shambling forward with broken swords and torches.
location: Dragon-Burnt Ruins, Fringefolk Hero's Grave

name: Twinsage Sorcerer
description: Senior masters of the Academy wearing twin-headed glintstone crowns, unleashing dual-pronged sorcerous volleys with devastating velocity.
location: Raya Lucaria Academy (Debate Parlor / Church)

name: Wraith Caller
description: Vile, hunched zealots who ring cursed bells to summon homing vengeful wraiths, riding spectral steeds through ruined marshes.
location: Ruins and marshes of Liurnia of the Lakes
